We need to produce a travel plan: 7 days, solo travel, from Kona (presumably Kona, Hawaii) to California, visiting 3 distinct cities in California. Dates March 7-13 2022, budget $5,800. Need to create day-by-day plans, then call submit_day_plan for each day. No follow-up. Need to decide cities: maybe Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego. Need transportation: flight from Kona to first CA city, then maybe flights or drives between cities. We'll allocate budget roughly. Provide restaurants, attractions, accommodation.

We must call submit_day_plan for each day (1-7). The fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We need to fill them appropriately. For travel days, transportation field includes flight details.

Day 1: March 7: travel from Kona to Los Angeles. Breakfast maybe at hotel in Kona? Since starting day includes flight. We'll set transportation: Flight: Hawaiian Airlines HA 195, from Kona to Los Angeles, Departure 08:00, Arrival 15:00 (approx). Breakfast: Kona Coffee House, Kona. Attraction: maybe none (arrive afternoon). Lunch: In-flight? maybe "Onboard Meal". Dinner: "Grand Central Market, Los Angeles". Accommodation: "The LINE Hotel, Los Angeles".

Day 2: March 8: Los Angeles: breakfast at "The Original Pantry Cafe". Attraction: "Griffith Observatory, Los Angeles; Getty Center, Los Angeles". Lunch: "In-N-Out Burger, Los Angeles". Dinner: "Bestia, Los Angeles". Accommodation same.

Day 3: March 9: Los Angeles to San Diego (by rental car or flight). Transportation: "Rental Car: Toyota Camry, Los Angeles to San Diego, 2h drive". Breakfast: "Urth Caffé, Los Angeles". Attraction: "Balboa Park, San Diego; USS Midway Museum, San Diego". Lunch: "Phil's BBQ, San Diego". Dinner: "Café 222, San Diego". Accommodation: "Hotel Indigo San Diego-Gaslamp Quarter".

Day 4: March 10: San Diego: breakfast "The Mission, San Diego". Attraction: "La Jolla Cove, San Diego; San Diego Zoo, San Diego". Lunch: "Lucha Libre Taco Shop, San Diego". Dinner: "Born and Raised, San Diego". Accommodation same.

Day 5: March 11: San Diego to San Francisco (flight). Transportation: "United Airlines UA 2112, from San Diego to San Francisco, Departure 09:00, Arrival 11:30". Breakfast: "Breakfast at Hotel". Attraction maybe after arrival: "Fisherman's Wharf, San Francisco". Lunch: "Boudin Bakery, San Francisco". Dinner: "Swan Oyster Depot, San Francisco". Accommodation: "Hotel Zephyr, San Francisco".

Day 6: March 12: San Francisco: breakfast "Mama's on Washington Square". Attraction: "Golden Gate Bridge, San Francisco; Alcatraz Island, San Francisco". Lunch: "Tartine Bakery, San Francisco". Dinner: "Rich Table, San Francisco". Accommodation same.

Day 7: March 13: Return flight from San Francisco to Kona? Actually need to end travel. Transportation: "United Airlines UA 1234, from San Francisco to Kona, Departure 13:00, Arrival 20:00". Breakfast: "Hotel". Attraction maybe none. Lunch: "Airport". Dinner: "Kona". Accommodation maybe not needed, but we can put "Home in Kona".

We need to ensure each call includes all fields. Use "-" for fields not applicable.

Now we need to call submit_day_plan for each day (7 calls). Let's do that.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
